title: DeBiasMe: De-biasing Human-AI Interactions with Metacognitive AIED (AI in Education) Interventions

bias_targets.methodology: Real-time AI-assisted text analysis of user prompts and AI-generated responses against a hierarchical bias taxonomy to detect and visualize human biases such as anchoring, confirmation, and automation bias.
Mapping and visualizing statistical, computational, and systemic biases in AI outputs using an interactive bias diagram to show how they interact with or reinforce user cognitive biases.
